user_story: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve task by valid ID
steps: Step 1: Ensure the task with ID 123 exists in the system.
Step 2: Send a GET request to /tasks/123.
Step 3: Receive and check the response.
positive.expected_result: HTTP status code 200 with full task details in the response body.

negative.title: Retrieve task by non-existent ID
steps: Step 1: Ensure no task exists with ID 999.
Step 2: Send a GET request to /tasks/999.
Step 3: Receive and check the response.
negative.expected_result: HTTP status code 404 with an error message indicating the task was not found.

edge.title: Retrieve task by boundary ID
steps: Step 1: Determine the boundary ID, for example, the maximum integer value the system supports.
Step 2: Send a GET request to /tasks/<boundary_id>.
Step 3: Receive and check the response.
edge.expected_result: HTTP status code 404 with an error message if no task exists, or 200 with task details if the task exists for the boundary ID.
